texts: An intact endothelium limits the initiation of clots by covering the tissue factor in the wall beneath it: C is the answer.
It also carries thrombomodulin and releases nitric oxide and prostacyclin, which keep the surface anticoagulant.
When the endothelium is damaged, tissue factor meets the blood and clotting begins.
Memory hook: the white tiles cover the red sparks; where one tile falls off, a beaver builds its dam.
